User.Response: "ive realized that when I stopped caring what everyone thinks of me and just worry about what i think of myself, im way better off. i tried for so many years to impress everyone and be the life of the party but not realizing i really didnt have true friends. The point at which I said I know I can do better, i started acting on it. When i go to the gym Monday-Saturday from 6-9am and lift, my day is so much fuller. The gym has change my life in everyway. Ive never had stable mental health while on all the prescribed and unprescribed medications. i stopped taking my medication mental health medication several moths ago and replaced it with being active. Ive never felt this amazing in my life. The more goals i act on, the more positive i feel about life. "

User.Response: "We are supposed to trust doctors to help us. i called the pharmacy after i woke up because they are open 24 hours a day. The pharmacist said the new medication cause interactions with my other medications as a result I experienced what I did today. i was so tired I contemplated doing speed to wake up. i had things I was supposed to do today. i made a new friend at work and he invited me over for a house warming get together. i told him what happened but I still think It upset him. It upset me because I couldnt go to gym nor doing anything I usually do. The doctor knew all my other medications so Im not sure why she would prescribe me aomething that would cause this reaction. like I said how am I supposed to trust medical professionals when they do this? This is like the 10th time either ive been given a medication that interacts with my other medications or going to an emergency for intense pain while being treated like a junkie seeking pills when in reality I had a serious issue going on that they didnt listen to me so I had to go to a specialist who took the time to investigate. I ended up needing surgery that particular time yet the ER staff said they couldnt help me and to seek rehab. This world is absolutely pathetic and I truly hope the end of times comes about with the upcoming years. There is so much evil and hate for one another because of the stupidity in peoples hearts. "

User.Response: "i work at a RCC. the drive to and from work is stressful. the people that come in to the center are still using drugs and it’s stressful at times working with that population. most of them are unpredictable, loud and make a mess of the place. they are not “in recovery” so basically the recovery community center is used for a drop in center for the unhoused drug using population to come in and get harm reduction supplies. when i work remotely i provide telephone support to people in recovery. but i also have to care for my children at home while i work because child care is unaffordable. i pay half my monthly income just to have them in daycare the two days a week i have to work in person at the drop in center. i do enjoy helping people but it is stressful and i sometimes feel burned out. changing jobs would likely mean working 5 days a week in person and i can’t imagine how much that childcare would cost for 2 kids. so i just keep doing what I’m doing one day at a time"

I helped My nephew navigate some things that he is trying to take care of from his father passing away. I am nervous about him going to the beach with his friends family. I talked to a guy that I sponsor who just got out of detox. overall was it a great day but I could have been more productive.

User.Response: I worked on homework and attended class virtually. I spoke with my medical provider about outstanding bills and financial assistance.  I spoke with the pharmacy for the 17th time about a refund that they owe me. I assisted a friend navigate her insurance. I gave my experience and knowledge of resources to a friend who is trying to get information about her 401k. I talked to several friends to invite them over for fireworks tomorrow. I'm trying to plan a get-together at my house for fireworks. I'm trying to figure out how to purchase and prepare food for tomorrow's gathering on a shoestring budget. I talk to my nephew about coming over for fireworks tomorrow. I talked to him about his bank account. We shared some funny videos. I offered my support to my nephew's grandmother who's husband is on hospice. We also shared good stories about my nephew's dad who recently passed away. she told me about my nephew coming to her house twice in the last week to work on his car and help her do on work.  I'm really glad to see that he's finally able to go to the house that he lived out with his dad. It deeply saddens me not my nephew lost his dad to an overdose. my heart breaks for my nephew. I'm extremely grateful that I am in recovery and can continue being his primary supporter, but nothing compares to him having his dad.

User.Response: My nephew left early this morning to go to the beach with his friend's family. I worry about his safety because I never know what could happen. We communicated through text about his trip and his bank account. I spent a few hours with him late last night helping him get ready for his trip. He talked with me about his frustrations with his mother. there has been an abandoned cat coming to my porch for a few days. I was able to get it scanned for a chip and into a rescue today. I feel great about that but it did cost me $100 surrender fee that are really couldn't afford. I went to a celebration of life for my uncle and got to connect with a lot of out-of-town family members. It was very nice. I also reconnected with some friends that I haven't seen in many years. then I went to the local recovery center for food fun fellowship and fireworks.  I got to connect with My people and meet some new people.

User.Response: I worked with a group on a homework assignment today. My nephew is on vacation with his friend's family and I assisted my nephew with his cash account.  He also needed me to send him a copy of his driver's license because he was trying to ride go-karts and left his wallet at their vacation rental.  I did not have a picture of his driver's license but I did have a picture of his permit which had his photo on it. I sent him that and I used his ID number to log into PennDOT to get information that he has a driver's license and sent it all to him by text.  He was very happy that it worked and I was very happy that he was able to drive the go-kart.  I attended my home group and then afterwards went with someone from the meeting to the local park to walk because we both want to start exercising.  The stressful point of my day was preparing paperwork for a mortgage that my husband and I are taking out on a vacation property. I'm extremely stressed because owning a property jointly did not work so well for us in the past.  I figured out some concerns and questions that I have and will contact an attorney tomorrow.
